summary: Explore the One Piece graph in the protected playground
need: Inspect connected wiki and semantic facts through an interactive graph client without building a separate application.
value: Query answers, an observed schema snapshot, and optionally newly committed demo facts attributed to the signed-in user.

stages.action: Opens the playground in a browser and signs in through the configured Cloudflare Access policy.
stages.sees: The protected query, write-facts, schema, and MCP connection interface.

stages.action: Runs a curated or free-form Datalog query and inspects returned rows and read metrics.
stages.sees: Typed graph results and per-query timing and snapshot information.

stages.action: Inspects observed fields or appends typed facts as an atomic transaction.
stages.sees: Fields and value tags from one snapshot, or a committed transaction receipt and read-back option.
